cause: The controller-triggered canary cancellation used GITHUB_TOKEN; GitHub suppresses most follow-on workflow events for that token, so the workflow_run observer did not start. This is the diagnosed cause consistent with the exact run inventory.
repair: The controller now explicitly dispatches the read-only observer for the exact canceled canary source run. The observer independently fetches Actions metadata and accepts only the exact canceled canary identity; the controller validates the exact observer run and receipt.
release_please_failure_observation: The workflow pushed generated index commit 4015070bca0be1411a5cfb27faed53a0413a088b to open release PR #302, then failed with post-push candidate does not point at the new writer SHA. A subsequent read reports PR #302 head exactly equals that writer SHA. No package publish occurred.
